passages.note: House Third Reading vote 31-26-3-0-0 on SB 1164 (2022); Bolick voted Y.
Bill status page lists Bolick as a co-sponsor of SB 1164 (2022).

passages.provision_quote: This act does not : 1. Create or recognize a right to abortion or alter generally accepted medical standards. The Legislature does not intend this act to make lawful an abortion that is currently unlawful. 2. Repeal, by implication or otherwise, section 13-3603, Arizona Revised Statutes, or any other applicable state law regulating or restricting abortion.
passages.note: Enacted bill text's construction clause disclaims any right to abortion and leaves other abortion-restricting law in force.

rows.reasoning: Bolick co-sponsored SB 1164 (2022) and voted Yea on its House Third Reading (31-26-3-0-0), a bill setting a 15-week gestational limit on abortion with a medical-emergency exception. Per its construction clause, the act 'does not ... Create or recognize a right to abortion' and does not repeal other state law restricting abortion, so under the annex's construction-clause ruling it evidences no permitted stage and shows only the restrictive side, not rung 3's 'allow abortion during the first trimester, and after that only to protect the mother's health.'
